note: TEMPORARY (18 Nov): the Hindi voices' second audition of the shout: the vowel doubled (चोओर) and drawn out by an ellipsis, for 'choorr choorr'. Restored to the English script in the next commit.
ref_text: The night was cold and very quiet. Most of the street was asleep, and the lamps hummed over the empty road. Somewhere far away, a train rolled past, and then the silence came back.
